title: Semester and Group Chat
author: Isandro Fairweather
blurb: Wendell Halloran, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
